title: A Splash of Fun Jet Ski Rental Co.
specs: Jet skis use 4-stroke technology, no mixing oil and gas required
Jet skis go 50-65 mph depending on conditions and occupancy
Must be 21 years of age to rent; operators must be 18 or older
Anyone born on or after September 1, 1993 must have a boater education certificate
Valid driver's license or identification required
Towing vehicle must have a tow hitch, 2-inch ball, and 4-prong flat connector
Maximum 3 people per jet ski, total weight 524 lbs
blurb: Rent jet skis including Honda Aquatrax F-12, Honda Aquatrax F-12x Turbo, and Yamaha EX Sport models. Skis seat 1 to 3 occupants and include safety equipment and full operating instructions. Rentals include jet ski, trailer, full tank of gas, life jackets, fire extinguisher, and tow rope.
extraNote: $50 non-refundable reservation deposit per ski required · $300 cash security deposit per ski required · Reservations may be canceled 48 hours before without fee; less than 48 hours incurs $50 cancellation fee per ski · No refund on date of reservation due to weather; cancel 48 hours before to avoid fee · Failure to show up results in full day's rental fees charged per ski

quotes.text: A Splash of Fun offers personal watercraft rentals at an affordable price without compromising the quality of the watercraft offered. Turn your next family gathering or corporate event into something that is both exciting and memorable. Our brand of enjoyment is unparalleled in the industry. A Splash of Fun's top quality, well-maintained watercraft and outstanding customer service separates us from the competition.
